purpose: Maps ingredient-level concern tags to a plain-language screening message, a severity and a short piece of context. Used by the DeepCos concern engine. This is screening of documented ingredient characteristics, not a safety verdict about the finished product or about an individual person.

fragrance.label: Fragrance present
fragrance.message: The formula contains fragrance material. Fragrance is one of the most frequently reported causes of cosmetic contact reactions.
fragrance.advice: Relevant if you know you react to scented products or prefer fragrance-free routines.

fragrance-allergen.label: Declared fragrance allergen
fragrance-allergen.message: One or more individual fragrance allergens from the EU labelling list were identified.
fragrance-allergen.advice: These must be declared on the label above a threshold; relevant mainly for fragrance-sensitive users.

essential-oil.label: Essential oil detected
essential-oil.message: The formula contains one or more essential oils. Essential oils are complex mixtures that frequently act as fragrance allergens.
essential-oil.advice: Oxidised essential oils carry a higher sensitisation risk, so storage and freshness matter.

exfoliating-acid.label: Exfoliating acid detected
exfoliating-acid.message: The formula contains an AHA / BHA / PHA or a related acid with exfoliating behaviour.
exfoliating-acid.advice: Relevant for sensitive or reactive skin. Exfoliating acids are also frequently combined with daily sun protection in the routine.

photosensitising.label: Sun-sensitivity consideration
photosensitising.message: At least one ingredient in the formula is associated with increased sensitivity to sunlight (phototoxicity or photosensitisation).
photosensitising.advice: Daytime sun protection is normally recommended alongside such ingredients.

potential-sensitizer.label: Potential sensitiser
potential-sensitizer.message: One or more ingredients in the formula are recognised as potential skin sensitisers for part of the population.
potential-sensitizer.advice: Most users tolerate these ingredients; patch testing is the usual way to check individual response.

formaldehyde-releaser.label: Formaldehyde-releasing preservative
formaldehyde-releaser.message: The formula contains a preservative that works by slowly releasing formaldehyde.
formaldehyde-releaser.advice: Formaldehyde releasers are among the better-known contact allergens; relevant information if you have a known formaldehyde allergy.

paraben.label: Paraben preservative
paraben.message: The formula uses a paraben-class preservative.
paraben.advice: Parabens are permitted in cosmetics with concentration limits in most markets; they are widely studied and generally well tolerated.

sulfate-surfactant.label: Sulfate surfactant
sulfate-surfactant.message: The formula contains a sulfate-type cleansing surfactant.
sulfate-surfactant.advice: Effective cleansers, but potentially stripping for dry or reactive skin.

drying-alcohol.label: Volatile drying alcohol
drying-alcohol.message: Denatured or isopropyl alcohol is present. At higher levels this gives a fast-drying finish but can be drying.
drying-alcohol.advice: Worth noting for dry or dehydrated skin, or when the alcohol appears high on the ingredient list.

comedogenic-potential.label: Comedogenic potential
comedogenic-potential.message: One or more ingredients in the formula have a documented pore-clogging (comedogenic) potential.
comedogenic-potential.advice: Relevant mainly for blemish-prone skin; comedogenic ratings are only a rough guide.

pregnancy-caution.label: Ingredient often reviewed during pregnancy
pregnancy-caution.message: The formula contains an ingredient that is commonly discussed in pregnancy-related skincare guidance.
pregnancy-caution.advice: DeepCos is not able to give medical advice. This is only a flag to raise with a healthcare professional if relevant to you.

environmental-concern.label: Environmental consideration
environmental-concern.message: One or more ingredients have documented environmental or regulatory review activity in some markets.
environmental-concern.advice: Environmental status varies by market and is not a statement about personal safety.

restricted.label: Regulatory restriction identified
restricted.message: An ingredient with a documented regulatory restriction or prohibition was identified in the ingredient list.
restricted.advice: Restrictions differ by jurisdiction and by concentration. Verify against the rules of the market where the product is sold.
